component.name: Engram
component.summary: Memory scanner and debugger for Linux that AI agents can drive
Сканер памяти и отладчик для Linux, которым могут управлять ИИ-агенты

description.p: Engram finds values such as health, gold or ammo in a running program, changes or freezes them, finds the code that writes them and saves pointer paths that survive restarts. It works with native Linux programs and with Windows games under Wine and Proton.

AI coding agents are full clients through an MCP server and a CLI: they work in the same session you see, and every memory write waits for your approval. Engram only attaches to ordinary processes of your own user.
